settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Organization, tax issuers, taxes, pipeline and team.

general.title: Organization
general.name: Name
general.slugLocked: It can't be changed: it would break shared links.
general.rulesDescription: Default values used by billing, payment collection and renewals.
general.description: The organization's name and its URL identifier.
general.paymentTermsHint: Days from issue until an invoice is due.
general.billingDayHint: From 1 to 31. In shorter months, the last day is used.
general.quoteValidityHint: If a quote doesn't say how long it's valid for, it expires this many days after it's sent.
general.concentrationAlertHint: The dashboard warns you if a single client exceeds this % of 12-month revenue.
general.targetHourlyRateHint: Projects compare what's invoiced divided by the hours spent against this figure: green if it's reached.

issuers.title: Tax issuers
issuers.description: Who issues each invoice. The company is the primary issuer.
issuers.formDescription: The tax details that will appear on its invoices.
issuers.registryInfoHint: Mercantile Registry: volume, folio and sheet (tomo, folio, hoja). Shown in the footer of the company's invoices.
issuers.pendingToggleHint: You can fill in the NIF and registration date once it exists.
issuers.linkedMemberHint: The partner who invoices as this self-employed issuer.
issuers.primaryHint: The one suggested by default when invoicing. There can only be one.
issuers.primaryLocked: To change it, mark another issuer as primary.
issuers.noSeries: This issuer doesn't have any invoice series yet.
issuers.empty: No issuers yet. Add the company or a self-employed partner.
issuers.archiveBody: It will no longer appear when invoicing. Its invoices and numbering are kept.
issuers.archivePrimary: The primary issuer can't be archived: mark another one as primary first.
issuers.createdToast: Issuer created with its invoice series
issuers.duplicateTaxId: There's already another issuer with that NIF.
issuers.notFound: It no longer exists or has been archived. Reload the page.
issuers.adjustDescription: To continue the numbering you were already using in another tool. Enter the last number you used.
issuers.counterBelowUsed: It can't be lower than this year's last invoice in the series ({last}): invoices already issued aren't renumbered.
issuers.newSeriesDescription: For invoices that were numbered differently (e.g. “2026-BRK-001”) or to keep a type of invoice apart.
issuers.newSeriesFootnote: The default series doesn't change: it keeps numbering what you issue from GNERAI OS. If the format includes the year, numbering starts again every year.
issuers.seriesFormatHint: '{yyyy}' or '{yy}' for the year and '{n}' for the number ('{n:3}' zero-padded: 001).
issuers.seriesCodeHint: Leave empty to derive it from the format.
issuers.seriesFormatInvalid: The format must include '{n}' (the number) and, if it has a year, '{yyyy}' or '{yy}'.
issuers.seriesFormatTaken: This issuer already has a series with the format {format}.
issuers.seriesCodeTaken: This issuer already has a series with the code {code}.

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.description: VAT rates and withholdings. An issued invoice keeps the rate it was issued with.
taxes.formDescription: A VAT or withholding rate available when invoicing.
taxes.name: Name
taxes.regimeHint: Outside the general regime, the rate is 0% and the invoice carries its legal note.
taxes.legalNoteHint: Printed on the PDF. Check it with your accountant.
taxes.defaultHint: Suggested on every new line. There can only be one VAT default and one IRPF default.
taxes.archiveBody: It will no longer be suggested when invoicing. Issued invoices keep the rate they were issued with.
taxes.notFound: That rate no longer exists or has been archived.

fiscalCalendar.title: Tax calendar
fiscalCalendar.description: The Spanish tax deadlines (AEAT) shown in the calendar and the ICS feed, by issuer type. Indicative: check it with your accountant.
fiscalCalendar.enabledHint: 303, 111, 130, 202… with their due date, in the right person's calendar: the SL's for everyone, each self-employed partner's for them.
fiscalCalendar.intraEuHint: Automatic: only if EU companies were invoiced in the last 12 months. Always: also for purchases such as Meta or Google Ads billed from Ireland.
fiscalCalendar.disclaimer: If the last day falls on a weekend, the deadline moves to Monday. Public holidays are not taken into account and, with direct debit, the deadline ends a few days earlier.

team.title: Team
team.description: Who has access to GNERAI OS and with which role.
team.inviteCreatedNoEmail: Invitation created. The email will be sent once the mail server is set up.
team.inviteDescription: They'll get a sign-in link by email and join with the role you choose.
team.name: Name
team.inviteFailed: Invitation saved, but the email didn't go out. Try resending it.
team.invitesDescription: They expire after 14 days. Resending one restarts the clock.
team.inviteNotFound: That invitation is no longer pending.
team.alreadyMember: That email has already accepted an invitation. If they don't have access, restore it from the member list.
team.memberNotFound: That member is no longer in the organization.
team.lastOwner: The organization needs at least one active owner.
team.cannotDeactivateSelf: You can't remove your own access.
team.selfDemoteBody: You'll lose access to the tax settings and the team as soon as you confirm. Only another owner can give it back to you.
team.deactivateBody: They won't be able to sign in to GNERAI OS. Their history is kept and you can restore their access whenever you like.

security.resetBody: Their authenticator app is removed and all their sessions are closed. They will set it up again next time they sign in with their password. Do it if they lost or changed their phone.
security.title: Access security
security.requireHint: Enforced by the database too: a session without the second step sees and changes nothing, even with a password.
security.requireBlocked: It can be turned on once everyone has set it up.
security.needOwnMfa: First, sign in with your own two-step verification.

preferences.title: Your profile
preferences.description: How you appear in the app and which language you use it in.
preferences.name: Name
preferences.initialsHint: 1 to 3 letters. Shown on cards and lists, and they tell apart partners with the same name.
preferences.languageHint: The interface language, across all your organizations.
preferences.themeDescription: How GNERAI OS looks on this device.
preferences.deviceDescription: Notifications on your phone or computer, and the installed app.

push.title: Push notifications
push.description: What can't wait reaches you even when GNERAI OS is closed: accepted quotes, reminders ready to send, renewals and billing failures.
push.enableFailed: Notifications could not be turned on for this device.
push.testSent: Test sent: it should arrive in a few seconds.
push.testBody: This is how the important things in GNERAI OS will reach you.
push.devices: {count, plural, one {# of your devices has notifications} other {# of your devices have notifications}}
push.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
push.iosInstall: On iPhone and iPad, notifications need the installed app: tap Share → “Add to Home Screen”, open GNERAI OS from the icon and turn them on here.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser settings and try again.
push.notConfigured: The server doesn't have the notification keys (VAPID) yet. They need to be set up before notifications can be turned on.
push.notRegistered: This device does not have notifications on.
push.gone: The browser unsubscribed this device. Turn notifications on again.
push.sendFailed: The test could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
push.installHint: Install it to open it like an app: with its own icon, full screen and shortcuts.
push.installed: You are using the installed app.

digest.title: Monday summary
digest.description: Every Monday morning, by email and on your devices: last week, what is coming, what is pending and how you are doing with your goals.
digest.toggleHint: Partners only. Your calendar items and everyone's.
digest.enabled: You will get the summary every Monday
digest.disabled: You will no longer get the weekly summary
digest.sentWithPush: Summary sent to your email and {count, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}}
digest.noEmail: No email service is configured (RESEND_API_KEY or BREVO_API_KEY).

preferences.securityDescription: Your access code, trusted devices and where you are signed in.

security.title: Access to your account
security.description: You sign in with your personal 8-digit code. Here you can see which devices you use it on.
security.mfaOn: On: you also enter the code from your app when signing in
security.mfaOff: Optional: also asks for the code from your authenticator app when signing in
security.passwordHint: To sign in with email and password if you don't have your code at hand.
security.sessionsHint: Signs you out of every other browser and phone; this one stays signed in.
security.othersDone: Signed out of your other devices
security.othersFailed: Your other sessions could not be closed. Try again.

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: What you aim for as partners. The dashboard shows every day how you are doing and what is left.
goals.mrrHint: Monthly recurring revenue before VAT you want to reach.
goals.mrrByHint: Leave it empty for the end of the year.
goals.revenueHint: Base before VAT for the whole year: invoiced plus signed counts.

accessCode.title: Access codes
accessCode.description: Each partner signs in with their personal 8-digit code. Here you can see which devices each of them has used it on.
accessCode.regenerateBody: The current code stops working right away. Trusted devices stay: you sign in the same way, with the new one.
accessCode.revealBody: Write it down now: for security it won't be shown again. Give it to them in person, never by email or in a group chat.
accessCode.revealSelfBody: Write it down now or save it in your password manager: for security it won't be shown again.
accessCode.devicesCount: {count, plural, =0 {No trusted devices} one {# trusted device} other {# trusted devices}}
accessCode.devicesHint: Where you sign in with just the code. Remove any you no longer use or have lost.
accessCode.noDevices: None yet: they're added when you sign in with the code.
accessCode.revokeMemberBody: {name}'s open sessions are closed too: to sign in from that device again they'll have to use their code again.
accessCode.revokeSelfBody: To sign in from there again you'll have to use your code again.
accessCode.revokeSelfOthersBody: Your other devices are signed out; to sign in from there again you'll have to use your code again.
accessCode.revokeCurrentBody: You stay signed in on this browser, but it's no longer trusted: next time you sign in here it will count as a new device.
accessCode.chooseBody: 8 digits you'll remember and nobody else knows. Avoid birthdays and phone numbers. Your current code stops working when you save.
accessCode.chosen: Code changed. The old one no longer works.

chooseErrors.format: It has to be exactly 8 digits.
chooseErrors.weak: Too easy to guess (repeated or sequential digits). Pick another one.
chooseErrors.taken: That code isn't available. Pick another one.
chooseErrors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
